If you'll forgive a little sappiness before Week 6:

I ran my first race today in over a decade. I wasn't nearly as fast as I used to be. But I was totally pain-free.

As a young runner, I was irresponsible about mileage and form and maintenance. Hurt my ankle + everything up the chain. At my worst points I couldn't stand or walk for long periods without pain.

It took a few (several) failed attempts at physical therapy and a total paradigm shift in how I stride, what shoes I wear, everything. But as of today, I'm really and officially back. 

So many failed returns made me forget the unique joy of distance running. I thought I would never feel it again, and I was resigned to that loss.

It's back. It's right where I left it, still warm after 10 years. I missed it so much and it was just waiting for me the whole time. Thank God. I'm so grateful.
